note: Reconstructed on 2026-10-28 from docs/V1-ROUND3.md section 5 to re-report Round 3 with two ladders and Holm's correction; it reproduces the ladders that document reports, and is not a decision taken before the data. Default ladder: each client at high (Claude Code's Haiku ran without an effort flag); top ladder: the highest effort each client was asked for (max; Codex ultra and Grok xhigh were not run). Model ids are as result.json records them. Required variants: the three variants every configuration ran on the test set (its three-variant headline); t1 and t3 were run by some configurations only, so they are not owed, and the memory set owes nothing (the real set, a real tier, owes all its tasks). The six configurations that did not run the real-building set list its four tasks as missing, so the real tier reports them as permanently missing rather than as unlisted gaps.
